list.title: Thanks for the Thessalonians' Faith Under Persecution
The Man of Lawlessness and the Call to Stand Firm
A Request for Prayer and a Warning Against Idleness

findings.problem: This passage joins two separate units. In 2 Thessalonians 3:1-5, Paul requests prayer and affirms the Lord's faithfulness; at 3:6, he begins a new argument commanding the church to avoid undisciplined believers and address idleness. The passage should break after 3:5, with the short first unit standing alone if it cannot truly join a neighbor.

rule.text: Break at natural turns: a new scene (the place, the time or the people change), a new speaker or speech, a new psalm, or the end of one argument and the start of the next.
